Original VirelaiOS GIF vector, repository LICENSE.

play10_160x120.gif:
Generated by the Go standard library image/gif encoder (gif.EncodeAll)
on the host — the same provenance as webrender/testdata/gif's
anim3_160x120.gif, generated rather than downloaded so the GOVIEW
playback leg runs on a real-encoder file. Ten 160x120 frames, 5
centiseconds each, NETSCAPE2.0 loop-forever; every frame slides a
diagonal 16-color band one step so each composite differs. Go is
BSD-3-Clause; image/gif is used here as an encoder only, never as a
guest decoder dependency.
